data.trigger: When an NPC becomes your focus or when you create a Bond towards an NPC
data.description:
Ask the Game Master a single question about that NPC, which the Game Master must answer truthfully. Then, describe what sensation revealed this information to you. You may use this gift only once on each NPC.

You Spend: @LOSS[max(5, (&cs('brainwave-clock')*5)) mp]{Lose Brainwave MP}
Progress: @CLOCK[brainwave-clock update 1]{Advance Brainwave Clock}
